The BPI story

Better Power.
A connected battery business.

Founded in 2002, Shenzhen Better Power Battery Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures lithium-ion, NiMH and NiZn batteries, battery packs and energy storage solutions.

The company operates three subsidiaries focused on lithium batteries, nickel batteries and energy solutions. Its footprint includes a Shenzhen headquarters, a Shenzhen pilot production base for battery packs and energy storage, and a Jiangxi industrial park.
